title: Evaluation of Trichoscopy in the Diagnosis of Tinea Capitis
brief_summary: Waiting for a proof by mycological culture is usually necessary before starting a systemic antifungal therapy. It therefore seems to us interesting to evaluate the benefit of using dermoscopy in clinical diagnosis of Tinea Capitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with clinically diagnosed tinea capitis
* Patient has signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with kerion or tinea favosa
* Antifungal treatment within 15 days prior to inclusion
